title: Patch: the account screen shows this ranked season's record beside the rank
thread:
**Issue #2255 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2255: Patch: the account screen shows this ranked season's record beside the rank Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means The account screen shows a player's rank in the current ranked season, plus one win–loss–draw record covering every game they have ever played. It never shows how they are doing this season, even though the server already sends that. Once this is built, the rank block also reads, for example, “This season (ranked): 14–9–1”, so a player can see their climb at a glance. ## Why - `GET /api/ranked` already answers `record` (games, wins, losses, draws) for the caller's current season (`crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs:718`, filled at `:742-747`), and the client types it (`apps/web/src/net/api.ts:1289`). - No client code reads it: `apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx:367-385` shows only `profile.record`, the all-time count from `/api/profile`, and the play lobby (`routes/play.tsx`) shows only the crest and its caption. ## Proposal - In the account screen's rank block, show the season's W–L–D from `getOwnRank`'s `record` under a clear label (“This season (ranked)”), and keep the all-time Record section as it is. Leave the line out while the season has 0 games. - Optionally add the same one line under the crest in the play lobby. - Client only; the strings go through `t()` with zh-CN entries. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx`, `account.test.tsx` (optionally `routes/play.tsx`) - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` - SPEC §9.12 ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] A ranked answer of 14 wins, 9 losses and 1 draw shows “14–9–1” under the season label (vitest). - [ ] With 0 season games the line is absent, and the all-time record is unchanged. - [ ] A failed ranked read shows exactly what it shows today. ## Size and risks Small, 2 to 3 files. Risk: two records side by side could confuse a player, so each label must say which record it is. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-1` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40736569895)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal On `/account`, the rank block shows a new line under the rank line. It reads “This season (ranked): 14–9–1”, taken from `GET /api/ranked`'s `record` (`getOwnRank`). The line is left out while `record.games` is 0, and it never shows when the ranked read fails, so that case looks exactly as it does today. The all-time Record section (`profile.record`, win rate, played) is unchanged. The new string goes through `t()` and gets a zh-CN entry. The decision is recorded as ruling R2255000, and §9.12's Reads bullet links it. ## Files to touch | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx` | change | `accountTestid.seasonRecord`; the season line in the `rank !== null` fragment | | `apps/web/src/routes/account.test.tsx` | change | three `R2255000 …` tests in `describe("the account screen")` | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | one entry for the new sentence | | `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.12 **Reads** bullet: the profile's season record, linking `[[R2255000]]` | | `spec/rulings/R2255000.md` | new | the ruling note | | `spec/pending/2255.md` | new | the §11 paragraph | Do not touch: `apps/web/src/routes/play.tsx` (see the Risks section), `apps/web/src/net/api.ts` (`OwnRankResponse.record` is already typed), anything in `crates/` (the server already sends `record`, `crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs` `own_rank`), `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/rulings/R0612.md`, `e2e/`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`. Governing: SPEC §9.12 (Reads), R612 (reads never carry the hidden rating; the profile shows tier, division, pips and badges), R661 (the lobby's rank), R2101000 (the flame beside the rank), R711000 (every `t()` literal has a zh-CN entry), CLAUDE.md rules 3 and 7. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx`, `accountTestid`** (line ~83). Directly after the line `rank: "account-rank",`, add: ```ts /** R2255000: this season's ranked win–loss–draw record, under the rank line; absent at 0 games. */ seasonRecord: "account-season-record", ``` 2. **`apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx`, the JSX of `AccountRoute`** (inside `{rank !== null ? (<> … ) : null}`, line ~331). Between the closing `

` of `

` and the opening `

`, insert: ```tsx {/* R2255000: the season's ranked record, labelled apart from the all-time Record below; none at 0 games. */} {rank.record.games > 0 ? (

{t("This season (ranked): {wins}–{losses}–{draws}", { wins: rank.record.wins, losses: rank.record.losses, draws: rank.record.draws, })}

) : null} ``` - The two dashes in the sentence are en dashes (U+2013), the same character as in `"W–L–D"` and in the record line at line ~377. - Change nothing else. The fetch effect (`getOwnRank(...).catch(() => undefined)`) stays as it is, so a failed read leaves `rank` null and the line never mounts. - The server counts `games` as wins + losses + draws (`crates/server/src/ranked/ladder.rs` `apply_ranked_game`), and it is 0 when the player has no season row. 3. **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`**. Directly after the line `"Season best:": "赛季最佳：",` (line 824), insert: ```json "This season (ranked): {wins}–{losses}–{draws}": "本赛季（排位）：{wins}–{losses}–{draws}", ``` - The key must match the `t()` literal byte for byte, en dashes included. - The `{wins}`, `{losses}` and `{draws}` tokens must match on both sides (`i18n.test.ts` checks this). - Keep the trailing comma, because the `"Record"` line follows it. 4. **`spec/rulings/R2255000.md`** (new). Write it exactly as below: ```markdown --- id: R2255000 title: "The profile shows this season's ranked record under its own label, beside the all-time record (issue #2255)" cards: "§9.12, R612, R661, issue #2255" proven_in: - apps/web/src/routes/account.test.tsx --- Presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no rule, state, event, endpoint or response changes. The account screen's rank block shows, under the rank line, the season's ranked record that `GET /api/ranked` already sends ([[R612]]'s `record`), as "This season (ranked): W–L–D", the wins, losses and draws of the current season's rated games. The line is left out while the season has no games, and when the rank cannot be read the screen shows what it showed before: the Rank heading with nothing under it. The Record section below keeps the all-time count from `GET /api/profile`, its heading and figures unchanged, so each record says which one it is. The Play online lobby's rank panel stays as [[R661]] has it. Hearthstone semantics: its profile shows the current season's ranked play beside the rank. Rejected: a "0–0–0" line before the first ranked game, which says nothing a Raisin rank does not; replacing or retitling the all-time Record, which the issue keeps as it is; and the same line in the Play lobby, which the issue left optional and [[R661]] does not include. ``` 5. **`spec/pending/2255.md`** (new). It holds one line: ```markdown **[[R2255000]] shows this season's ranked record on the profile (issue #2255, 2026-10-28)**: the account screen's rank block reads "This season (ranked): W–L–D" from `GET /api/ranked`'s `record`, left out while the season has no games and when the rank cannot be read, while the all-time Record section stays as it was. It takes R2255000, the first number of issue #2255's block, and edits [[§9.12]]. ``` 6. **`spec/09-architecture.md`, §9.12, the `- **Reads.**` bullet** (line 216). Replace exactly this text: `the profile shows its tier, division and pips with its season badges, and the Play online lobby` with: `the profile shows its tier, division and pips with its season badges and, from the season's first ranked game, its win–loss–draw record for the season, labelled apart from the all-time record ([[R2255000]]), and the Play online lobby` Change nothing else in the bullet. 7. **`apps/web/src/routes/account.test.tsx`**. Inside `describe("the account screen", …)`, directly after the test `"R2101000 shows no flame below the threshold, nor once a loss has set the streak to 0"` and before that `describe`'s closing `});` (line ~359), add the three tests from the **Tests** section. They use only names the file already imports (`getProfile`, `getOwnRank`, `render`, `screen`, `accountTestid`, `profileBody`, `rankBody`, `TOKEN`), so the imports do not change. ## Tests File `apps/web/src/routes/account.test.tsx`. In every test, `profileBody()`'s all-time record is 7–2–1 and the season record differs from it. ```tsx it("R2255000 shows this season's ranked record under its label, beside the rank and apart from the all-time record", async () => { vi.mocked(getProfile).mockResolvedValue(profileBody()); vi.mocked(getOwnRank).mockResolvedValue(rankBody({ record: { games: 24, wins: 14, losses: 9, draws: 1 } })); render(); const season = await screen.findByTestId(accountTestid.seasonRecord); expect(season).toHaveTextContent("This season (ranked): 14–9–1"); expect(screen.getByTestId(accountTestid.rank).nextElementSibling).toBe(season); expect(screen.getByTestId(accountTestid.record)).toHaveTextContent("7–2–1"); }); it("R2255000 leaves the season line out while the season has no games, the all-time record unchanged", async () => { vi.mocked(getProfile).mockResolvedValue(profileBody()); vi.mocked(getOwnRank).mockResolvedValue(rankBody({ record: { games: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, draws: 0 } })); render(); await screen.findByTestId(accountTestid.rank); expect(screen.queryByTestId(accountTestid.seasonRecord)).toBeNull(); expect(screen.queryByText(/This season \(ranked\)/)).toBeNull(); expect(screen.getByTestId(accountTestid.record)).toHaveTextContent("7–2–1"); expect(screen.getByTestId(accountTestid.winRate)).toHaveTextContent("70%"); }); it("R2255000 a failed ranked read shows what it showed before: the Rank heading alone and the record as it was", async () => { vi.mocked(getProfile).mockResolvedValue(profileBody()); vi.mocked(getOwnRank).mockRejectedValue(new Error("the ladder is down")); render(); expect(await screen.findByTestId(accountTestid.record)).toHaveTextContent("7–2–1"); expect(getOwnRank).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { name: "Rank" })).toBeInTheDocument(); expect(screen.queryByTestId(accountTestid.rank)).toBeNull(); expect(screen.queryByTestId(accountTestid.badges)).toBeNull(); expect(screen.queryByTestId(accountTestid.seasonRecord)).toBeNull(); expect(screen.getByTestId(accountTestid.winRate)).toHaveTextContent("70%"); expect(screen.queryByRole("alert")).toBeNull(); }); ``` Before the change, test 1 fails (no `account-season-record`). Tests 2 and 3 pin the absent cases. `apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` is unchanged. Its `"R711000 every sentence the client wraps in t() has a zh-CN entry"` and `"R711000 every zh-CN.json dictionary entry has matching parameter tokens with its English key"` tests prove step 3. Commands, from the repository root (the web tests need the WASM build first, or vitest fails to resolve `src/wasm/pkg`): ``` sh scripts/build-wasm.sh pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/account.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/routes/account.tsx apps/web/src/routes/account.test.tsx cargo jackioh spec check ``` ## Done when - [ ] A ranked answer of 14 wins, 9 losses and 1 draw shows “This season (ranked): 14–9–1” directly under the rank line (test 1). - [ ] With `record.games` 0 the line is absent, and the all-time record and win rate are unchanged (test 2). - [ ] A failed `getOwnRank` shows only the Rank heading and the Record section, with no alert (test 3). - [ ] The new sentence goes through `t()` and has a zh-CN entry; both R711000 tests pass. - [ ] `R2255000.md`, `spec/pending/2255.md` and the §9.12 edit are in place, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes. - [ ] Every account test passes, including the existing ones (their default `rankBody()` now also shows the season line), and so do typecheck and eslint. - [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests and web tests. A red one is reported by name, never skipped. - [ ] Two decisions are recorded in the PR body: the lobby line was skipped, and the Record heading was kept. ## Risks - **Hidden information (rule 7).** Only the player's own season counts are shown, and the server already sends them to that player. No rating is shown (R612). - **Existing tests.** The default `rankBody()` has `games: 10`, so every existing account test now renders the season line too. Each existing assertion targets its own testid (`account-rank`, `account-record`) and none is a whole-screen text match on a record, so none should break. If one does, fix the test's selector, never the new line. - **e2e.** `e2e/cypress/e2e/99-online-smoke.cy.ts:411-412` matches the text of `account-rank` and `account-record` with regexes. The new line is a separate `

` with its own testid, so neither text changes. Spec 46 (R1581000, one screen) is unaffected because `/account`'s body scrolls in its own region. Spec 47 (tap areas) is unaffected because a `

` is not a control. - **i18n key drift.** A hyphen typed instead of the en dash in either the `t()` literal or the JSON key fails `R711000 every sentence … has a zh-CN entry`. Copy both from this plan. - **Spec check.** The test titles must contain `R2255000` as a word, the note's `proven_in` must list the test file, and `cards` must name only things that exist (`§9.12`, `R612`, `R661`, `issue #2255`). Do not edit `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`. - **Play lobby (optional in the issue) is not built.** R661 says what the lobby's rank panel shows, so adding a record there would mean amending R661 for an optional extra. The alternative was to add it to `routes/play.tsx` and amend R661. ## Open questions - Should the all-time section's heading change from “Record” to “All-time record”? The issue says to keep that section as it is and lists two records side by side as a risk. This plan keeps “Record”, because the new line carries its own “This season (ranked)” label. A person may prefer the rename in a follow-up. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-28T17:25:52Z: Approve ````
